name: Telekom Malaysia Berhad
overview: 2026年，TM 通过向 Maxis Broadband 授予 2G/4G 国内漫游及 4G MOCN 服务合约，扩大移动覆盖范围；同时与 Maxis Broadband 的经常性关联交易金额超过 1% 门槛，并寻求股东更新及新增相关授权。此外，公司宣派了 2025 财年特别股息及第二中期股息，以及 2026 财年第一、第二中期股息。
overview_en: In 2026, TM expanded mobile coverage by awarding Maxis Broadband a contract for 2G/4G domestic roaming and 4G MOCN services; recurrent related party transactions with Maxis Broadband exceeded the 1% threshold, and the company sought shareholder renewal and additional mandates. TM also declared a special dividend and second interim dividend for FY2025, and first and second interim dividends for FY2026.

segments.name: 综合宽带、移动及数据服务
segments.name_en: Integrated broadband, mobile and data services
segments.note: 通过向 Maxis Broadband 授予 2G/4G 国内漫游及 4G MOCN 服务合约，扩大全国移动覆盖。
segments.note_en: Expanded nationwide mobile coverage by awarding Maxis Broadband a contract for 2G/4G domestic roaming and 4G MOCN services.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 向 Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd 授予 2G 和 4G 国内漫游服务及 4G 多运营商核心网（MOCN）服务合约，服务期至 2029 年 9 月 30 日。
actions.text_en: Awarded Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd a contract for 2G and 4G domestic roaming services and 4G Multi Operator Core Network (MOCN) services, valid until 30 September 2029.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 与 Maxis Broadband 的经常性关联交易金额超过 1% 门槛，并寻求股东更新及新增相关授权。
segments.note_en: Recurrent related party transactions with Maxis Broadband exceeded the 1% threshold, and shareholder renewal and additional mandates were sought.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 宣布与 Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd 的经常性关联交易金额进一步超过 1% 门槛。
actions.text_en: Announced that recurrent related party transactions with Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd further exceeded the 1% threshold.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 披露 2025 年 8 月 15 日至 2026 年 1 月 31 日期间与 Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd 的经常性关联交易合计金额超过 1% 门槛。
actions.text_en: Disclosed that aggregate recurrent related party transactions with Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd for the period 15 August 2025 to 31 January 2026 exceeded the 1% threshold.
